Screen headings are cut off between views; one visible heading is about a licence-holding company managing your portfolio, but its title is not showing. The "עמלת חליפין" entry matches the FX conversion fee I'm looking for, so I'm continuing through the screens.

content.text:
**What I'd tell a colleague:** This page lists what the site doesn't cover, and the list is long. Roughly 30 product cards are all tagged "לא מחושב", and a short list at the bottom names things it will never do. The bottom list bites for me: "בחירת מניות, מסחר ונגזרים" is out of scope for good, so my single tech stocks get nothing here. The worse gap is "עמלת חליפין", the bank's shekel-to-dollar conversion fee. It sits in the not-calculated pile, so the site can't yet tell me what I lose every time I buy my US ETFs. I'm fairly sure of all this, because the page names it all outright.

**Not calculated yet ("לא מחושב"):**
- **Commodities and currency:** ETC, LBMA gold price, gold through a fund ("השקעה בזהב דרך קרנות סל"), currency-hedged funds ("מנוטרלת מט"ח"), "פיקדון במט"ח", "חשבון מטבע חוץ", the digital FX wallet (LAYA), and "צמוד דולר".
- **Bonds and debt:** "אג"ח קונצרניות", "אגרת בונדס", "תעודות התחייבות", "ניירות ערך מסחריים", debt restructuring ("הסדר חוב"), rating companies ("חברת דירוג"), and the bond trustee card (only half visible).
- **Insurance and pension:** "ביטוח מנהלים", "קופת ביטוח", profit-sharing life insurance ("ביטוח חיים משתתף ברווחים"), "קרן י'", and the insurance investment tracks ("מסלולי האירוח").
- **Structured products and managed money:** "מוצר מובנה", "פיקדון מובנה", "מענק", "שיווק השקעות", "תיק השקעות דיגיטלי", and a portfolio-management card whose heading was cut off.
- **Tax and annuities:** "קרן להשקעות במקרקעין" (REIT), "קצבה מוכרת" and selling it for a lump sum ("היוון"), "תיקון 190", and "תשלומים פטורים".

**Never, by design ("מה האתר לא משווה ולא עושה"):** loans and mortgages, insurance other than risk policies, stock picking and trading, physical property, ranking by past returns, automatic allocation, executing anything, and user accounts.

**What I looked at:** The title, the red banner, every card's name and its "לא מחושב" tag, a few "מצב הכיסוי" folds that list open questions, the "never" list, and the footer.

**What I skimmed or skipped:** I skimmed most of the "מה ידוע" definitions. I skipped the law citations, the "חוקים וכללים" counts, and the closed questions that are crossed out.

**Where I hesitated:**
- A few card headings fell between screenshots, so I may have missed a name or two.
- Exactly what "פי החברה" means on the orange tags. My guess is "the company's own word".
- How a closed question ("נסגר ב־") relates to the card still saying "לא מחושב".

**What bothered me:**
- The page has zero numbers. It's a catalogue of gaps.
- The same "כשייסגר: יופיע במדריך…" line is copy-pasted on every card, with no dates.
- The ETC card says "מקור ראשי" but cites ESMA, a European regulator, for an Israeli site.
- On the plus side, the footer says "אישי, לא מסחרי, בלי קישורי שיווק" and I saw no broker names.

**Would I have closed the tab?** Once I saw the FX fee was "לא מחושב", yes. It answered today's question but gives me nothing to compare with what I pay now.
